criteria.silhouette_scale: Large four-spoke octagon balances compact horizontal engine and low T-shaped foundation. Normalize scale to actual structure coordinates in blockout.
criteria.implementable_geometry: Cuboids, four 45-degree rim corners, cylinder bands and a short exhaust are native-model feasible. Copper utility area reduces to existing rear slab.
criteria.mechanics_clearance: Overhung wheel now has visible air below rim. Short axle into supported crankcase is buildable; model must set perpendicular cylinder/shaft axes explicitly and measure swept wheel gap.
criteria.period_materials: Readable medium iron and restrained brass fit late nineteenth-century machinery.
criteria.family_consistency: Blue-gray planes and edge seams match refinery reference; noise should be quieter in final texture.
criteria.controls_readability: Open controller sides and simple dial clear.
criteria.gameplay_scope: Existing controller/ports/component count retained; crankcase is visual cylinder subgeometry, not another required block.
